notes.title: Patch 0.9 Release
notes.content:
[h1] Patch 0.9 [/h1]
Welcome to the next update for Robot Revolt, patch 0.9. Originally intended as two seperate patches, a halloween update was rolled together with a feature update. We hope you enjoy! 

Our next patch (Coming Soon TM) will focus on reworking items and weapons, including added new ones. We feel like the game is finally getting close to a solid base from which to expand upon. 

	[h2]Highlights[/h2]
- new map progression added (final, we promise!)
- added difficulty, first 5 are available, more coming in further patches
- reworked unlock system (for example the market is something you unlock)
- new biome
- attributes are rebalanced, simpler to understand but stronger
- added new transition screen
- added screenshake (can soon be disabled in options)
- knockback reworked, should be much more reliable now
- added new sound tracks and removed some old ones

[h2]New Map Progression: Portals[/h2]

Above certain difficulty levels, you must use portals to advance
Portals show the location (biome) - each biome now has their own mostly unique enemies
Portals also have boons and banes, powerful rewards and penalties, choose wisely!
Each vehicle now starts in their own starting biome

[h2]Enemies[/h2]
Added enemies:
[list]
[*] monowheel soldier
[*] centaur 
[*] sidecart soldiers
[*] cactus 
[*] cactus dynamite
[*] chickens on brooms
[*] exploding pumpkins
[*] The Coffin
[/list]

- each biome has it's own variant of the starter enemy
- enemy bullets are now rendered on top for more visibility
- elite specialists now deploy heavy towers
- enemies will now spread out more
- loot goblin will now drop credits when shot
- loot goblin now drops a lot of credits on death, instead of a chest
- enemies respawn rather than die when out of bounds
- fixed shadows not updating correctly (when flying/knocked back)
- fixed 1 member in groups moving faster

	[h2]GUI[/h2]
- When enabled, healthbars only appear when enemies have taken damage
- nearby indicator no longer stuck on screen
- all menu back buttons are improved
- credits back button fixed
- reworked unlock gui since shop was removed
- unlock gui now shows how many unlocks you have

	[h2]Weapons[/h2]
- fixed swarm rockets not despawning correctly (performance)
- fixed muzzle flashes not despawning correctly (performance)
- shotgun deals more damage to targets up close

	[h2]Items[/h2]
- rebalanced Recycler
- renamed Mountain to Armor Plates
- Scythes assigned correct icon

notes.title: 1 Year Anniversary
notes.content:
[h1]Happy Anniversary[/h1]
and a happy new year! 
Phew, 1 year is a long time. It has been a hectic year and unfortunately we haven't had time to work as much as we wanted. A lot of stuff was delayed and sometimes we were too silent about it, sorry!
Even today should have been a relatively large patch we have been trying to finish.

We have a lot of ideas and unfortunately the game didn't go as well as we hoped. We still intend to finish most of our ideas but in a lesser capacity. Over the next months (no specifics ːsteamhappyː) we will release updates featuring some of the tweaks and changes we have been working on:
[list]
[*]New map progression system: portals
[*]Re-worked items and weapons, bigger upgrades at level 4 and 8
[*]Remove diskette unlock shop in favor of a "star" system, earn stars and unlock new stuff
[*]Unique vehicle traits which can be unlocked for other vehicles by getting three (tbd) stars 
[*]New enemy behaviours for each biome, including a skirmisher behaviour that should spice up ranged enemies
[*]A few weapons that have been planned for some time, including "black hole"
[*]A few items, such as "viking helmet"
[*]Reworked boss fight and maybe even a new boss
[/list]
[h2]Next Patch 0.9[/h2]
Coming very soon, hopefully days and not [i]weeks[/i], is patch 0.9 where the main feature is the new map progression system.

In short, at the 5 and 10 minute marker, you must select between different random portals. Each portal leads to a different biome which has unique enemies and sometimes obstacles. Furthermore, each portal gives a boon and a bane (not pictured), making the choice not as simple.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43192333/555c56254b3398ad851d09a86c03edf256bd48fe.png[/img]

With this change we also made per biome unique enemy lists and new enemies, making each biome feel different and varied. A lot of enemies were also somewhat rebalanced. A few existing enemies have had their final behaviours added, such as a radar "summoning" or flags "buffing".

Originally intended as a halloween update, this patch also includes the "spooky" biome with new enemies such as the coffin or toy robot.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43192333/b1865f95ca2f2521f62f8deb00eeecff1df4b971.png[/img]

[h2]Mini Roadmap[/h2]
Patch 0.9: New map progression, enemies and spooky biome (soon)
Patch 0.X: Weapon and Item revamp + some new weapons and items
Patch 0.X: Unique vehicle traits and vehicle revamp

In between these specific patches we have plans for new enemies, weapons and items but not specifically assigned to any patch. 

Following this will be 1.0 which will include a decent chunk of content, we will try and make a final push around this time to see if the game can gain some traction. This will be used to determine the game's future.

Thanks for following us and we hope you enjoy the coming content!

notes.title: Patch 0.8
notes.content:
Welcome to patch 0.8

Compared to the last two patches, this one is rather small.

- Random Biomes on each playthrough inlcuding new "desert" biome
- Enemies have been tweaked to better match the genre, 50% more enemies, 50% less speed
- New Spiderling behaviour: They will jump and attach to you.
- New Specialist behaviour: Jetpack around and spawn towers

We currently have an increase in time to spend on the game so expect some major updates during the summer. We hope to have 0.9 ready soon.

Also, the summer sale will be the last chance to get the game cheaply. In patch 0.10 after the summer sale the game will increase in price to around 6 dollars (depending on region). 

Patch 0.10 will also most likely be the last major patch before the final release (with a lot of goodies also). Unfortunately we feel the game didn't really hit its stride and will be moving on after implementing most of our backlog of ideas (unless we get a burst of popularity).

Have a great summer!

- team dytdyt

notes.title: Update 0.7 Launch
notes.content:
[h1]Finally, patch 0.7 is here! [/h1]
It is finally here, took a lot of work and we hope you like it! The headlines:

[list]
[*] Controller Support added (keyboard also!)
[*] Auto-aim added to all weapons (manual mode can be toggled)
[*] The Ice, EMP and Fire elemental statuses have been implemented
[*] Rebalanced game, no difficulties, more enemies
[*] New textures and colors
[*] 3 new weapons and 2 new items
[*] 2 new vehicles
[*] Various gameplay tweaks
[*] A beta boss fight
[/list]

Controller support has been added! It should work fully but unfortunately none of us regularly use a controller and we had to improvise :) We really would like your feedback to get this into proper working order. For now we consider this to be in [b]beta[/b].

Auto-aim options added. By default all weapons are now auto-aim. Some weapons can be toggled to use manual aim in the pause-menu. The default behaviour can be changed in options.

Elemental statuses implemented, fire damage causes DoT, ice damage causes a stacking slow and EMP damage cause targets to take bonus damage.

Difficulties have been removed. The only difficulty now is actually a combination of the previous three. Was removed as we felt it really didn't add anything to the game.

Colors have been added to the game. We tried going for a style and felt it never really hit the spot. We have now added new textures and colors to the environment.

Extensive, but not complete, list of changes:

[h2]Weapons and Items[/h2]
- maximum level for weapons and items has been increased from 6 -> 8
- Fire damage added. Deals more damage over time.
- EMP damage added. Electrifies targets, causing them to take increased damage.
- Ice damage added. Slows enemies. Stacks.
- new weapon: Frozen orb
- new weapon: Scythes
- new weapon: Shotgun
- Machine Gun "ammo" upgrade replaced with piercing upgrade
- Death Roller now has a chance to drop repair kits w/ upgrade
- Ground Spear rebalanced to focus more on heavy hits and fewer spears
- new item: Heavy Metal
- new item: Corpse Exploder
- Mortar bounce effect will now bounce a random direction

[h2]Enemies[/h2]
- reduced damage by around 30%
- suicide enemy has been added. Will explode when close after a short delay.
- zombots have reduced health from 150 to 120
- zombots no longer have any resistances
- enemy bullets have improved flight mechanics making it easier to judge positions
- reduced number of enemies in special waves by around 30%

[h2]Vehicles[/h2]
- vehicles now have custom amounts of weapon and item slots
- vehicles now have more prominent abilities
- luck now increases pickup range

[h2]Gameplay Improvements[/h2]
- difficulties removed
- auto-aim added
- controller support added (beta)
- full keyboard support added
- you now keep all traits you found even if you die
- rare and legendary traits have 5x higher drop rate (was extremely low before)
- number of enemies increased by 30-50%
- take reduced damage when hit multiple times in quick succession
- your current location is always shown under the timer
- market and factories now show their coordinates
- repair kits can no longer drop from crates

A whole lot of random fixes and tweaks

notes.title: New Update 0.6
notes.content:
[h1]PATCH NOTES 0.6[/h1]

[h2]Unlocks Added[/h2]
- Unlocks have been added. They can be purchased in the main menu for diskettes found ingame. They include new vehicles, items and weapon. Quite few items and weapons previously available have been locked but we're are sure that you will get them again soon.

[h2]Traits Added[/h2]
- Traits have been added. They can be found in dungeons and include various powerful passive effects as well as increases to strength, agility, intellect and luck.
- Traits are looted from dungeons but at the end of the game you must choose which to keep.
- Traits can be ranked up which increases the attributes granted.

[h2]Level generation[/h2]
- A new level system has been made.
- Instead of choosing specific levels it is now randomized.
- Difficulty can be selected at the beginning. Rare and beyond traits drop from higher difficulties.

[h2]Various tweaks and fixes[/h2]
- Rebalanced health and damage values to begin a bit easier.
- Enemies now increase in health, damage and speed each minute.
- Factories have deadly traps.
- Resolution menu should work better.
- AoE scaling implemented correctly (some weapons nerfed as result).
- Updated various weapon and item upgrades to better explain their effect.

Achievements will be added in 1-2 days. A bug prevented it from being ready.

The next patch is 0.7 which will focus on adding some new items and weapons as well as reworking some of the existing ones.

Thanks for playing and if you enjoy the game, please consider telling your friends!

team dytdyt
